messages:
Nina: Quick — draft of a ClearLedger customer case is ready. Can we confirm interview slot and logo/benchmark approvals?
Jordan: Nice. Drop the one-pager here and Ill start social hooks once quotes are confirmed.
Nina: One-pager: "ClearLedger reduced inference cost 2.7x and improved p95 latency from 380ms -> 95ms after migrating to Redwood Dedicated. Includes migration timeline, sample prompt, and exec quote placeholder."
Eli: They offered asynchronous Q&A or a 20-30min recorded session. Which do we prefer?
Nina: Live recorded session so we can pull clips; async only if execs demand it. I tentatively asked for May 22 at 10:00 PT.
Harper: Legal flag  we need signed permission for the logo and the exact numbers. We can offer an anonymized publish option ("Leading payments customer") if they insist. Also request a 72-hour redline window by default.
Nina: Will request logo (svg/png), signed metric confirmation, and the redline window.
Jordan: Landing page copy idea: "How a fintech cut inference cost 2.7x and drove p95 to 95ms  join the webinar for the technical playbook." That should work as the promo hook.
Eli: Routing: send registrants to jordan@redwood and tag as "clearledger-demo". I'll wire the nurture flow.
LegalBot: AUTOMATED: Approval form created (case_study_approvals/3100001111). Please attach signed permission within 7 days.
Nina: Sent the packet to ClearLedger. UPDATE 3100001150  they confirmed the slot and said legal will sign, but asked to shorten redline to 24 hours.
Harper: 24h redline is acceptable. Also ask them to confirm the exact attribution text they want under the quote.
Nina: Done. Also asked whether they'd like any numbers anonymized.
Jordan: Can someone draft a 2-line internal product blurb for SRE/Platform before publish? Need it by May 25 so teams can prep docs and runbooks.
Eli: I'll draft the blurb.
Nina: Thanks everyone. Will post again when the signed approval is attached. :rocket:
